name: everforest
description: Comfortable & Pleasant Color Scheme for Visual Studio Code
readme:
# Everforest

A green based, warm and soft color scheme: **Everforest Dark** and Everforest Light. After installing, reload the window and pick a theme with `Preferences: Color Theme` (Ctrl+K Ctrl+T), or set `"workbench.colorTheme": "Everforest Dark"` in settings.json.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode. The themes are verified with their default options; the extension options that regenerate the theme files were not checked in Diode.
